units.rawText: You think my previous style of fortune-telling was not lying to, but rather helping people? ...Your attitude seems quite different from the others, Professor.

units.rawText: Of course, I think so too.

units.rawText: Not everybody has the courage to face life head-on. I simply want to give them the strength to do so in this way.

units.rawText: They don't even need to believe it. It's enough if they think, "My fortune says my luck is going to get better," even for just a moment.
